notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least three loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Hesitation and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types.
Whenever a player casts a spell, the Hesitation token triggers, countering that spell and causing you to fail to sacrifice it due to The Master.
Repeat step 2 as necessary.
